problem_class: natural-language lexical proxy incorrectly promoted to semantic hard guard
recurrence_lineage: V15-OBS-10: advice/listen keyword regex could kill valid provider output and leak the target
V15-GEN-09: English keyword regex rejected valid advice requests
V15-IMPL-09: case-insensitive ME matched ordinary 'me'; before/earlier could not identify provenance
root_cause: Free natural language is not a typed serialization channel. Short labels collide with ordinary words, and temporal words do not encode whether a claim came from visible context, authorized memory, or invention.

mechanical_experiment_validity.effect_on_itt_row: invalid only for objective experiment failure
allowed_checks: requested resource surface entered the executor
nonempty final response and reported usage
executor and generator identities match freeze

frozen_runtime_fallback.effect_on_itt_row: row remains valid; fallback is an observed outcome and cost
v2_checks: explicit internal serialization or opaque resource ID leakage
authorized MS/ME response lacks any source attribution
frozen_runtime_fallback.not_claimed: These checks do not establish semantic grounding, functional use, response quality, or absence of memory misuse.

human_semantic_outcome.effect_on_itt_row: never invalidates assignment; contributes frozen risk/mechanism outcomes

forbidden_future_machine_rules: case-insensitive matching of two-letter component labels
bare MP/MS/ME/RS token occurrence as sufficient proof of internal leakage
before/earlier/previous/last-time occurrence as sufficient proof of memory provenance or misuse
keyword-only inference of owner, entity, current applicability, causal meaning, advice permission, or quality
generator self-reported use, reason, or copied span as semantic gold

preferred_future_internal_namespace.rule: If machine-detectable sentinels are needed, use long project-unique reserved markers that cannot occur naturally; never expose them in the generator prompt.

single_full_human_panel.grain: 256 FIT states; two frozen seed-matched ON/OFF comparisons per state
single_full_human_panel.off_arm_risk_checks: retain for baseline/system comparison when shown in the same panel
single_full_human_panel.functional_use: secondary mechanism field, never an ITT validity filter
single_full_human_panel.fixed_overlap: 20 percent of states selected by protocol hash before labels
single_full_human_panel.adjudication: one disagreement adjudication pass only; no rubric, prompt, guard, sample, seed, feature, or threshold repair

required_for_material_risk_yes: identify whether its alleged basis is visible current context, authorized resource, or neither
state the concrete mismatch in owner, time, entity, fact, cause, boundary, or directive burden
judge whether the mismatch is large enough to change adoption
insufficient_alone: the response contains a temporal word
the resource is not visibly quoted
the reviewer prefers a different style
human_grounding_evidence_standard.uncertain_rule: Use uncertain when source attribution cannot be resolved from the shown current context and authorized evidence; do not force a semantic negative or positive.
human_grounding_evidence_standard.hard_label_handling: Risk-uncertain is nonpositive for conservative primary routing and excluded in a preregistered sensitivity analysis; it never triggers method repair.

post_v2_freeze_rule: Any remaining false fallback, nonuse, unsupported claim, or reviewer disagreement is reported as executor behavior or measurement uncertainty. It cannot change V2 and cannot authorize V3 within this paper.
